svg.title: Dreams progress: packed systems and components
svg.desc: Nested system and component map. Every function is one identical square. Every displayed component has its full label and checked/identified count. Container space includes label padding and does not measure system size. Full code-unit names are listed in the breakdown below.

g.text: 1,540 functions mapped to parts of Dreams | 27 names checked
One square = one function. Green: checked name. Amber: unresolved review. Gray: not reviewed.
8,011 functions still need system mapping. Full system sizes and completion remain unknown.
Compare identical squares and counts. Section space includes readable labels; empty space carries no progress status.
